journal_lines: All three at once. The forest, the rock, and the prey gave way together. A rare kind of day.
Prey flushed from the tree line into a cave seam. Took all three to sort it out. Worth it.
The hunt led through timber into stone. Everyone worked. Everything counted.
Timber above ore above prey, all in one place. All in one day.
The quarry went into the forest, and the forest into the hillside. Followed all of it.
Everyone working the same ground made it twice as fast and three times as productive.
The forest broke and opened into a cave seam and the prey was waiting beyond it.
A day when everything lined up. Rarer than the finds themselves.
Worked until every bag was full. Three kinds of work, one long afternoon.
A convergence. The forest, the stone, and the prey. Don't plan for these. Just work them.
The hunt started one thing and ended three. All of them done right.
Three skills, one place, no wasted motion.
